description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of entries in the 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset based on the presence or absence of reference answers and test cases. It is divided into three segments: the largest, colored pink, represents entries with neither a reference answer nor a test case (“Null”), accounting for 39.2% (549,238 entries); the second largest, in blue, corresponds to entries that have a reference answer (38.9%, or 543,935 entries); and the smallest segment, in light green, indicates entries that have a test case (21.9%, or 306,818 entries). The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner and percentage labels directly on each slice, with the title “Distribution of Reference Answer and Test Case” centered below. The segments are ordered roughly clockwise from largest to smallest, visually emphasizing the near-equal proportions of “Null” and “Have reference answer” categories, with “Have test case” being distinctly smaller.
